What is Reel It?

A simple way to get your moment captured.

Reel It connects customers with nearby people who can capture photos and short form video during everyday moments.

You live the moment

Choose when, where and what you want captured. A Reelo handles the camera while you stay present.

BookYour time and place
MatchA nearby Reelo accepts
ReceiveYour agreed content

One booking. Two opportunities.

A customer keeps a memory. A creative person gains flexible paid work and a chance to build a reputation.

For peoplePhotos and reels
For creatorsFlexible requests
For businessesRegular content
Why now

India is becoming a video first, content powered market.

People share more of everyday life through short form content, while local businesses and creators need flexible ways to produce it.

Content is everyday communication

Travel, celebrations, personal brands and local businesses increasingly rely on photos and short videos.

Creative skills can create opportunity

Reel It is designed to help capable people turn an eye for content into flexible local work.

How it works

Book. Match.
Capture. Receive.

No calls and no negotiation. Four simple steps help move a request from booking to delivery.

▣
01

Book

Choose when, where and what you want captured. Add the occasion, preferences and session details.

Typical booking time: about 45 seconds
◎
02

Match

Eligible nearby Reelos receive the request. The first valid acceptance secures the booking.

Response time depends on local availability
◷
03

Capture

Meet at the agreed location, follow the ETA and stay present while your Reelo captures the moment.

Sessions can start from 20 minutes
↓
04

Receive

The Reelo uploads the agreed content. Review it, download it and report any delivery issue in the app.

Delivery time is shown before booking

Trust & safety

Built for trust, especially when it matters.

For women, first dates, solo travellers and anyone meeting someone new, Reel It is designed to support a safer experience from booking through delivery.

Reviewed Reelo profiles

Every Reelo submits a live selfie and profile for review before accepting paid bookings. Reviews normally take 24 to 48 hours.

Know who captures your moment

View the assigned Reelo’s profile, portfolio and available ratings before the session begins.

Safer meeting guidance

For first bookings, we strongly recommend public, well lit cafés, parks, landmarks and event venues.

Your footage stays yours

Reelos must follow the footage policy and cannot publish customer content without permission.
